description: This file contains functions and types related to handling 'no-show' events in a booking system, including webhook payload preparation, participant retrieval, and event logging.

methods.name: sendWebhookPayload
methods.description: Sends a webhook payload with booking and participant details, handling different trigger events and errors.

methods.name: calculateMaxStartTime
methods.description: Calculates the maximum start time in Unix timestamp based on start time, duration, and time unit.

methods.name: fireNoShowUpdatedEvent
methods.description: Logs and triggers an event when a no-show is detected or updated for a booking.

methods.name: prepareNoShowTrigger
methods.description: Prepares data for a no-show trigger, including fetching booking details, meeting participants, and determining who joined the call.
